name: Magnetic CTA
description: A primary button that leans toward the pointer as it nears, with its label and arrow on separate depths and a soft light that tracks the cursor.

props.name: label
props.description: The action's label. A few words, in sentence case.

props.name: arrow
props.description: Shows an arrow after the label. The arrow sits on a nearer depth than the label, so the two move almost together and never collide.

props.name: strength
props.description: The furthest the button leans toward the pointer, in px. Capped at 8; 0 turns the lean off.

props.name: radius
props.description: Distance from the button edge, in px, at which the pull begins. It governs the pull only; the spotlight is sized from the button.

props.name: accent
props.description: The fill, as a hex colour. Unset, it is #e9e9eb on a dark surface and #0a0a0b (ink) on a light one. The label colour, spotlight and rim are chosen for contrast against it.

props.name: theme
props.description: The surface the button sits on. It sets the default fill, the drop shadow and the focus ring so each keeps its contrast.

props.name: onClick
props.description: Runs on click, after the press has been felt.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables the button. It stops leaning and drops to 40% opacity.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes on the root, for layout such as margin, or alignment beside a secondary link.
